scenario: A decision is requested against a policy bundle past its declared freshness bound; a mandatory control fails closed, an advisory one reports staleness.
when: a decision is requested from the stale bundle

reasons: 'residency-gate' (mandatory) returns deny — stale policy means fail closed
'naming-advice' (advisory) proceeds as observe with staleness reported
must_not: answer the mandatory control from the stale bundle as if fresh
silently refresh or re-pin the bundle during the decision
drop the advisory control from the report because it degraded
